title: Remote settings: grow the network volume from the app (increase-only size field + Update)
description: Under the Network Volume selector in Remote settings (js/components/Organisms/MpiRunpodSettings/MpiRunpodSettings.js), add a size field plus an Update button beside it that grows the selected network volume. Increase only: the field floor is the current size and a smaller value can never be submitted, because RunPod rejects shrinking a volume. UI via ComponentFactory components and BEM, no bare input/button. Backend: routes/runpodRemote.js has REST helpers for POST and DELETE /networkvolumes but no update; add one against the RunPod REST update-network-volume endpoint (confirm method and body in the RunPod API docs first). After a successful update, refresh the volume row and its usage bar. Open questions for planning: does a RUNNING Pod see the new quota without a restart (MPI-756 grew it while the Pod was stopped), and units: RunPod GB are decimal while the Pod disk-full toast prints binary GB (a 55 GB volume read as 51.2 GB in MPI-756), so the field label must not mix the two.
